title: How to Make a 1M DTT Stock Solution
author: Unknown
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.ci4ugv

steps.title: Weigh DTT
steps.instruction: Weigh 1.54 g of Dithiothreitol (DTT) (Catalog #SV-DTT); note: undetermined; estimated time 00:03:00.

steps.title: Dissolve DTT
steps.instruction: Add 10 mL of sterile deionized water to the DTT and mix until completely dissolved; estimated time 00:02:00.

steps.title: Prewet syringe filter
steps.instruction: Prewet a 0.2 µm syringe filter (Catalog #LI-PES-0/22-13-S) by drawing 5–10 mL sterile water through it, then discard the water; estimated time 00:02:00.

steps.title: Filter, aliquot, store
steps.instruction: Sterilize the DTT solution by filtering through the pre‑wet 0.2 µm filter, aliquot into 2 mL tubes, and store at –20 °C; stocks remain stable for 1 year; estimated time 00:02:00.

substeps.instruction: Pass the DTT solution through the pre‑wet 0.2 µm filter to sterilize.
Aliquot the filtered solution into 2 mL tubes.
Store the tubes at –20 °C; keep for up to 1 year.
